summary: VEILFALL: Ashes of the Nine is an isometric action RPG whose main place carries Broken Lantern Road past the Tollhouse, Dripping Gate and Bailiff's Court, then across the Wax Veil to the Penitent Climb and Ashen Abbey yard. A separate solo Veil stage hosts realm/Bearer menus; player, UI, camera and the main-place referee connect persistence, combat, quests and room-shared music, while authored scenes combine procedural dressing with bespoke models.
places: places/main/ - playable Z01 from Wayside Fire through Tollhouse, Dripping Gate and Bailiff's Court, across the Wax Veil to the Penitent Climb and Ashen Abbey yard; sim.js coordinates NPCs, quest stages, enemy packs, progression and ambience.

places/main/cells/x0z0.scene, x0z-1.scene and x0z-2.scene - 3 authored cells/214 placements across camp, road, court, climb and Abbey yard; Abbey cells now include a burned facade and bell tower, penitent wheels, brazier lighting and static grave/saint dressing.
places/main/config.yaml - main terrain, atmosphere and procedural vegetation; terrain materials use anti-tiling, stronger normals and macro variation.
places/veil/ - ephemeral solo menu stage: Lantern Shrine ledge above a misty ravine; hidden menu body is parked there.
places/veil/cells/x0z0.scene, x0z-1.scene and x0z-2.scene; places/veil/config.yaml - shrine/ledge, cliffs, far ridge, spawn and menu-stage atmosphere.
roots: world.config.yaml - world entry: main default place, player/camera templates, lighting, arrival behavior, nametag, desktop actions and touch surfaces; touch controller is scripts/controls.js.
templates/player.js - body combines humanoid-locomotion.js and scripts/player.js, assigns the Bladewraith model/layout and carried-light child.
templates/camera.js - custom camera template running scripts/camera.js.
places/main/sim.js - Z01 referee for NPCs, enemy/petition/quest stages, levels, reward turn-in, local ambience and road/fight/boss/Abbey audio beds; spawned Deacons receive the censer child.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene, x0z-1.scene and x0z-2.scene - authored playable dressing from camp and road to the Bailiff arena, Wax Veil, Penitent Climb and Abbey front/yard.
places/veil/cells/x0z0.scene, x0z-1.scene and x0z-2.scene plus places/veil/config.yaml - authored menu-stage shrine/ravine and its spawn/environment.
places/veil/sim.js - Veil wind emitter and menu-theme selection when no eligible Bearer is on main.
scripts/arrival.js - world doorway behavior; saves an active Bearer when leaving main.
shared: scripts/lib/character.js - Bearer schema, fresh state, realm roster/create/load/save/delete and position packing; used by player and arrival behavior.
scripts/db.js - characters table migration and owner/realm/name/class/level/zone plus JSON save schema.
scripts/lib/data/realms.yml - account character cap and realm room/name registry used by player menus and UI.
scripts/lib/data/economy.yml and scripts/lib/coins.js - money/drop/shop values and copper formatting shared by sim, drops, shop and HUD.
scripts/lib/data/combat.yml - hero, enemy (including chorister), skill, guard and Bailiff tuning consumed by combat scripts and HUD.
scripts/lib/data/veilfall-map.js - shared Z01 floor/areas, Abbey road and Wax Veil seal geometry; terrain, player movement and zone banners use its data/functions.
scripts/lib/data/menu-shot.yml and scripts/lib/data/models.js - Veil camera framing and CDN model IDs/metre heights/body(kind) helper used by camera and main sim/enemy spawning/Bailiff.

art/roadkit/common.py - offline Blender construction/material/render helpers imported by roadkit and art/abbey builders; art/abbey/belltower.py authors the ruined bell-tower GLB, not runtime behavior.
notableExports: places/main/sim.js - cadence, tick; places/veil/sim.js - cadence, tick.
scripts/wax-pack.js - roll, telegraph, hurtPlayers, payout, update; scripts/bailiff.js - onSpawn, update.
scripts/lib/character.js - CHAR_KEYS, fresh, START, realmOf, pack, zoneOf, rollName, roster, create, load, save, remove.
scripts/censer-swing.js - onSpawn; scripts/gen/censer.js - geometry; scripts/gen/penitent-wheel.js - geometry, collider.
scripts/camera.js - onInput, update; scripts/arrival.js - onArrive, onLeave; scripts/controls.js - default touch-surface selector.
scripts/lib/frames.js - FRAME_CSS; scripts/lib/data/ui-kit.js - default; scripts/ui.js - default; scripts/lib/data/veilfall-map.js - ABBEY_ROAD, ABBEY_SEAL, sealSide, floorDist, AREAS, areaAt.
ownership: scripts/lib/character.js CHAR_KEYS - persistent Bearer fields including seen area IDs; position is packed separately, transient UI/movement state is not saved.

scripts/player.js - active body's movement, combat, death/i-frame and skill timers, menu/selection scratch, current area/banner/foe HUD projection, footsteps cadence and low-life vignette; hydrates and saves the selected Bearer.

places/main/sim.js - per-player Z01 quest stage/dialog/kills baseline and claimed turn-in reward; place orchestration, NPC/shop-open distance behavior, enemy packs, ambience and road/fight/boss/Abbey music mood/tail.
scripts/wax-pack.js - ordinary enemy AI/hp/death and nearby eligible Bearers' XP/copper/kills/shards payouts; includes data-driven chorister kind.
scripts/bailiff.js - boss hp/phases/casts, arena reset, ledger pillars/walkers and Fray; publishes place.state.boss and bailiffDownAt.
scripts/lib/shop.js - trade validation and buyer copper, tonics, bag and maxHp mutations; shop-open state is on player.state.
scripts/censer-swing.js - spawned censer child rotation tween; its generator supplies geometry and child FX supplies smoking/glow presentation.
scripts/camera.js - camera zoom/follow and menu/arrival framing; scripts/ui.js renders menus and gameplay panels from player/place state.
flows: world.config.yaml attaches scripts/player.js through templates/player.js and maps desktop/touch actions; UI menu buttons send menu action data → player.js routes title/realm/character/create/enter/logout.
player.js menuInput → character.js roster/create/load/remove using caller-owned character rows; realms.yml maps selected realm to room and Bearer fields hydrate player.state.
While player.state.menu is set, player.js hides the body and crosses to solo place veil → realm and Bearer screens remain state-driven, with no characters in that place.

scripts/controls.js reads ctx.player.state.menu/shop/bagOpen → world.config.yaml chooses empty menu touch surface or default movement/skill buttons; UI panels continue receiving their own button actions.

scripts/ui.js draws title, realm, Bearer screens and HUD from player/place state → menu/shop/combat actions return through player.js; named Maelin/Oswin dialogue prefixes select portrait/nameplate and animate spoken lines; boss phase/hp and quest state feed HUD.

scripts/ui.js calls scripts/lib/shop-ui.js shopPanel when player.state.shop is set → shop buttons send shop action data; shop-ui.js uses economy/UI data and portrait/item icons, while scripts/lib/shop.js validates and applies trades.
scripts/camera.js reads target.state.menu and menu-shot.yml for the Veil shot; when entering play it cranes into follow view.
player.js saves changed CHAR_KEYS plus position periodically and on rest → character.js writes characters; arrival.js also saves an active character leaving main.

player.js uses veilfall-map.js floorDist for reachable click goals and floor-constrained movement/dash → quest stage 4+ (or place.state.abbeyOpenAll) enables ABBEY_OPEN, so the Wax Veil gates floor access until the Bailiff is down.

player.js zoneTick reads areaAt at the Bearer's position → transient player.state.area/banner drives UI banner; first entry adds area ID to persistent seen and emits a player-targeted milestone and discovery sound.

places/main/sim.js selects pack kind and scripts/lib/data/models.js body → combat.yml tunes pilgrim/chorister/deacon stats; deacon enemySpec adds the censer child → censer-swing.js loops its rotation tween while child FX emit smoke/glow; player.js strikes mutate enemy.state.hp → wax-pack.js resolves ordinary deaths and eligible payouts.

main sim musicTick selects road/fight/boss mood and spawns local ambience beds including Abbey choir/bell; Veil sim selects menu theme and wind only when no eligible Bearer is on main → both coordinate through the room-shared jukebox.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/gen/hub-*.js - reusable Wayside Fire camp props varied by instance params, seed and scene transform; share hub-kit.js.
scripts/gen/vf-*.js other than vf-ruin.js - Broken Lantern Road landmarks/clutter varied by parameters and seeds, built with vf-kit.js.
scripts/gen/vf-ruin.js - road, arena, Wax Veil approach, Veil ashlar and Abbey door braziers; kind and dimensions select forms, seed varies geometry.
scripts/gen/veil-land.js - Veil ledge, cliff and distant ridge forms selected by params.kind and dimensions/coordinates.
scripts/gen/veil-shrine.js - unique Lantern Shrine of the Nine; exported structure/constants describe its steps, states, chain, hooks and clusters.
scripts/gen/arena-floor.js, arena-pillar.js, gibbet.js and toll-throne.js - Bailiff arena dressing generators sharing scripts/gen/shapes.js; shared WAXC palette is soot-stained dark wax.

scripts/gen/abbey-litter.js and scripts/gen/abbey-court.js - Abbey yard floor dressing; litter varies by kind/seed/transform, court makes ringed slabs and a cleaner path to its local -Z door sill; penitent-wheel.js adds seeded varied roadside wheel shrines.

scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - shared body/input locomotion on player and wax enemy actors; CDN bodies/heights vary by kind; art/roadkit and art/abbey Blender builders author static models using shared roadkit helpers.
probableOrphans: scripts/gen/wax-figure.js - legacy procedural enemy-figure generator; current placed and spawned wax actors use CDN models instead.
migrationNotes: Persistent character data is exactly scripts/lib/character.js CHAR_KEYS plus packed position; seen is persistent per-Bearer, while area/banner/foe, menu and movement state remain transient. Add persistent fields to CHAR_KEYS.

Character rows are caller-owned and realm-bound; character.js scopes roster/load/save by owner and realm, while live names are unique per realm. realms.yml room IDs are routing identities, not places in this tree.
The Veil is solo and ephemeral, has no characters, and parks the hidden menu body at its origin; menu framing in camera.js is tuned by menu-shot.yml against that stage's shrine/ledge layout.

The music jukebox is room-shared, not owned independently by each place: main sim changes it for road/fight/boss/Abbey only when an eligible Bearer is on main; Veil supplies the menu theme when no one is on the road.

Player attacks directly mutate enemy.state.hp; ordinary-enemy death, XP and kill credit are resolved later by wax-pack.js. Preserve that handoff and its menu/charId eligibility check; Deacons are ordinary enemies with a visual censer child, not a separate combat owner.

ABBEY_ROAD/ABBEY coordinates in veilfall-map.js are world metres; player.js gates floorDist through quest stage 4+ (Bailiff down) or abbeyOpenAll. The Wax Veil seal-side boundary and placed seal at (12.3,-118.7), yaw 31.6 remain coupled to this floor gate.
